description: List the files linked in one Canvas assignment's instructions, such as a handout or a rubric, with the file name, type, size and a link. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name and assignment as the assignment ID or its name. It does not download or open the files. Example: "What files come with the Lab 4 assignment in Networking 1?"

assignment.description: The assignment ID or the assignment name, for example Lab 4. Ask get_assignments for the list.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.

name: get_assignment_files
title: Assignment files
